article.title: Tear gas, mass arrests as France halts classes over student protests
article.author: Editor
article.content: France suspends high school classes after one of its largest student protests in decades, with 6,100 arrests, hundreds injured and tear gas used in cities. The post Tear gas, mass arrests as France halts classes over student protests appeared first on MR Online .
